decision: Allow at most two qualified independent neural jobs per physical GPU 2/3; no third job.
evidence: Existing equal-work benchmark: 110.079892819s serial versus 85.249334686s parallel, 1.291269817x aggregate throughput.
reason_no_new_neural_job_started: The independent parent evaluation finished. New R1 optimization needs all current action labels; other inference paths and RGB210 data still need qualification.
limitation: The short collection benchmark does not establish the speedup of every heterogeneous workload or of the future training phase.
